description: The file defines kernel package configurations for the OpenWrt build system, specifically for BCM63xx platform support related to PCMCIA and USB device controller modules. It contains package definitions, dependencies, and file paths for kernel modules.

methods.name: KernelPackage/pcmcia-bcm63xx
methods.description: Defines the BCM63xx PCMCIA support package with properties like submenu, title, dependencies, config, files, and autoload settings.

methods.name: KernelPackage/pcmcia-bcm63xx/description
methods.description: Provides a textual description of the BCM63xx PCMCIA kernel support, indicating it’s for PCMCIA/CardBus controller support on BCM63xx SoCs.

methods.name: KernelPackage/bcm63xx-udc
methods.description: Defines the BCM63xx USB device controller support kernel package, including title, dependencies, config, module files, and autoload info.

methods.name: KernelPackage/bcm63xx-udc/description
methods.description: Provides a textual description for the USB gadget controller support for BCM63xx SoC.
